title: Last year to deduct PS savings
message: {lastDeductionYear} is the last year for eligible PS contributions to qualify for a deduction, generally within a {max} € combined annual cap and other conditions. The existing balance is not deductible. Check eligibility before paying in more.
earns: Nordea earns nothing from this information.
_note: Student concept. Figures read on the official source on the checkedAt date; not tax or legal advice.
explain: {lastDeductionYear} is the last year for eligible PS contributions to qualify for a deduction, generally within a {max} € combined annual cap and other conditions. The existing balance is not deductible. Check eligibility before paying in more. Contributions from {endDate} are not deductible. The historical test is total PS savings no more than {max} € on {endDate}, not today’s balance. The whole balance may qualify for withdrawal in {firstWithdrawalYear} or {lastWithdrawalYear} without punitive tax uplift. Nordea excludes a lump sum if retirement age has already been reached and scheduled withdrawals have started. Normal tax still applies, depending on the applicable withdrawal rules and total capital income, not a guaranteed tax-free payment.
